findings.summary: S.webapp.qualification requires recording the goal's desiredDepth at confirmation, but qualifiedDepth is still typed enum light|meaningful|shared-time, so a goal with the new 'any' depth cannot be recorded.

The rule to count only qualifications matching the current desiredDepth now conflicts with 'any accepts every logged depth', because it is unspecified whether events confirmed under a specific depth count after switching to 'any' (or vice versa), and SchedulePreview depends on that rule.
